title: Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ
author: Lew Wallace
summary: A Jewish nobleman in Roman-ruled Judea is falsely condemned to the galleys after a childhood friend, now a Roman officer, betrays him. He survives and returns, seeking revenge, as another figure's story unfolds alongside his own.
readIf: you like a 19th-century adventure with sea battles, a famous chariot race and a religious thread.
skipIf: you dislike old-fashioned style or a novel with overtly Christian themes.

pairings.reason: Another tale of a man wrongly condemned who returns for justice, with a brisker, wittier plot.
Another large-scale historical adventure about an outsider dropped into a foreign power struggle.
A different take on ancient history, told closely from a woman's view.
